name: comp-327

frames.best_why: Frame 2 shows the whole dialog from the icon to the magic link with every field visible.

tagline: Invite dialog adds email rows and copies a referral link.
summary: A trigger opens a dark dialog where you can add several teammate emails, send invites, and copy a read-only magic link with a one-click copy button.
appearance: Closed, an outlined Invite members button. Open, a tall dark rounded dialog: a circled person-plus icon, a bold left-aligned title and grey subtitle, three stacked email fields, an underlined + Add another, a white full-width Send invites, a divider, and a read-only magic link field with a copy icon.
behaviour: Opening focuses the empty email field. Add another appends a row, the copy icon copies the link and flips to a green check for a moment, and Send invites does nothing.
demo_content: Prefilled emails mark@yourcompany.com and jane@yourcompany.com; magic link https://coss.com/ui/refer/87689.
search_phrases: send invites modal with email fields
use_when: You want to invite several teammates by email or share a referral link from one dialog.
avoid_when: Sending is not wired and the magic link is a fixed example URL.
customise: Seeded emails, the magic link URL and all labels are hardcoded; adding a row is the only live behaviour.
weight_why: One dialog with a short email array and a clipboard call.

a11y.note: The copy button is labelled and focus moves to the last email, but the email label is not bound to those inputs.

issues: Send invites has no handler, so invites are never sent.
The email label is not associated with the repeated email inputs.
polish_why: Well-organised dialog with add-row and copy feedback; sending is not wired.
title: Invite Members Dialog
